title: Hi. Is there any plan for Spike (on Ios) to act as Xdrip follower
body:
I've two androids smartphones both with Xdrip installed. One as master, the other one as follower. I installed now Spike on my iphone and I would like to know if it can act as follower of the master Xdrip. It seems not at them moment but maybe there is a workaround.
thank you
Riccardo

comments.body:
Currently You gotta make xdrip upload to nightscout, and then use spike as a nightscout follower.
Talking to Miguel and Johan, there are vague plans to implement google firebase, which is the(or one of) messaging protocol used by xdrip

Many thanks for you kind reply

I was thinking that Spike could follow Xdrip sooner or later

Thank you
Kind regards

Riccardo
